name: theme-native
title: Theme: native (per platform)
description: The theme of the platform the app runs on: `nativeTheme()` returns Apple's on iOS and macOS, Material on Android, Fluent on Windows, and the default theme elsewhere, for `selectTheme(nativeTheme())`. Installs themes/native/index.ts with the themes it names (themes/apple/, themes/material/, themes/fluent/, themes/default/).
